turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so you have about twenty minutes. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that?
You didn't answer my question. Who decided Owen gets a zero, and did anyone hear from him before it went in?
I admire how you fight for your kids. I'd have wanted a mom like you.
Save it, Hale. I asked who decided the zero, and I'm still waiting for an answer.
We really want the same thing here, you and me. We're on the same team.
Then why did my son see a zero on his phone before anyone picked up the phone to me? I'll ask once more: who decided, and on what basis?
So as teammates, can we just move forward?
We are not teammates. Answer the question, or I'm going upstairs to the principal's office, and I'll ask her instead.
